evidence: Wants Oklahoma teacher pay among the top in the region and a statewide literacy director with a 3rd-grade reading gate (Oct 2026); no funding-formula plan.

LaunchPad Florida plan would link high schools, community colleges and employers for paid apprenticeships in construction, manufacturing, defense (Nov 2026).

'We're not going to expand Medicaid,' saying it would crowd out other priorities (Oct 2026).
